recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It restores the FHIR-25458 trial-use signal in current core source and leaves the larger complex artifact-organization design to IG Publisher/Tooling IG follow-up.
issue_request: FHIR-25458 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked for better multi-level organization of ImplementationGuide artifacts. The final direction was to keep the existing grouping and grouping references in core, mark them STU/trial-use, and let Composition/List-based organization evolve in implementation-guide tooling.
initial_application: No FHIR source commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-25458. The current source still had ImplementationGuide.definition.grouping and ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.groupingId; in R5 the whole ImplementationGuide resource was trial-use, but a later R6 normative sweep made the resource normative without preserving explicit trial-use status on grouping.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2021-03-08 record the vote to mark the grouping attribute STU. The referenced Zulip thread and HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#647 show the broader organizer-resource work belongs in tooling/Tooling IG evolution. Later FHIR-51435 deferred making groupingId repeatable because current tools rely on artifacts appearing in one group, so this reconciliation did not change cardinality.
reconciliation: Updated source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml to add structuredefinition-standards-status=trial-use to ImplementationGuide.definition.grouping and ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.groupingId, and added comments noting the grouping mechanism remains trial-use while more flexible tooling approaches are evaluated.
source_changes: source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml: added element-level trial-use standards-status extensions to ImplementationGuide.definition.grouping and ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.groupingId and updated their comments with the trial-use/evaluation note.

related_jiras.note: Later Deferred/Considered for Future Use request to make ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.groupingId repeatable; it confirms current tooling dependence on one grouping but does not change the FHIR-25458 trial-use status fix.
